title: Regulation of PCSK9 During Oxidized LDL-Induced Foam Cell Formation in RAW264.7 Cells.
authors: Howlader, Md Sariful Islam; Das, Manjusri; Hansda, Surajit; Siraj, Md Afjalus; Das, Hiranmoy
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨氧化LDL诱导泡沫细胞中KLF2与PCSK9表达关联，并含小分子与PCSK9的分子对接，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) is traditionally known for regulating plasma LDL cholesterol levels via LDL receptor degradation. This exploratory study examined the association between chemically induced changes in Kruppel-like factor 2 (KLF2), a vasoprotective transcription factor, and PCSK9 expression under ox-LDL-induced conditions in RAW264.7 cells. In silico molecular docking was also performed to determine whether GGTI298 could adopt a predicted binding pose within PCSK9. KLF2 was modulated by adding GGPP (a chemical inhibitor) and GGTI298 (a chemical activator) to the monocytes. Quantitative real-time PCR and immunocytochemistry were used to assess KLF2 and PCSK9 expression. Molecular docking was performed to examine the interaction between GGTI298 and PCSK9 using computational tools. Results show that ox-LDL significantly increased PCSK9 expression in monocytes during foam cell formation. However, GGPP significantly increased PCSK9 expression. In contrast, GGTI298 markedly reduced PCSK9 expression, suggesting a negative regulatory role of KLF2. Docking studies revealed that GGTI298 binds to the PCSK9 catalytic domain with favorable binding energy, forming stable hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions with key amino acid residues, indicating potential interference with PCSK9 function. GGTI298 suppresses PCSK9 expression during foam cell formation, highlighting its protective role. The dual ability of GGTI298 to enhance KLF2 expression and directly bind to PCSK9 underscores its potential as a therapeutic agent for managing foam cell formation that leads to atherosclerosis. The findings demonstrate an inverse association between KLF2 and PCSK9 expression following chemical treatment under ox-LDL-induced conditions. However, direct KLF2-dependent regulation of PCSK9, direct GGTI298-PCSK9 binding, and functional inhibition of PCSK9 were not established and require further genetic, biochemical, and functional validation.
abstract_zh: 前蛋白转化酶枯草溶菌素/kexin 9型（PCSK9）传统上已知通过低密度脂蛋白受体降解来调节血浆LDL胆固醇水平。本探索性研究考察了在ox-LDL诱导条件下，RAW264.7细胞中化学诱导的Kruppel样因子2（KLF2）（一种血管保护性转录因子）变化与PCSK9表达之间的关联。同时进行了计算机模拟分子对接，以确定GGTI298是否能在PCSK9内采用预测的结合构象。通过向单核细胞中添加GGPP（一种化学抑制剂）和GGTI298（一种化学激活剂）来调节KLF2。使用实时定量PCR和免疫细胞化学评估KLF2和PCSK9的表达。利用计算工具进行分子对接，以检查GGTI298与PCSK9之间的相互作用。结果表明，在泡沫细胞形成过程中，ox-LDL显著增加了单核细胞中PCSK9的表达。然而，GGPP显著增加了PCSK9的表达。相比之下，GGTI298显著降低了PCSK9的表达，提示KLF2具有负调控作用。对接研究显示，GGTI298以有利的结合能结合到PCSK9催化结构域，与关键氨基酸残基形成稳定的氢键和疏水相互作用，表明其可能干扰PCSK9功能。GGTI298在泡沫细胞形成过程中抑制PCSK9表达，凸显了其保护作用。GGTI298增强KLF2表达并直接结合PCSK9的双重能力，强调了其作为管理导致动脉粥样硬化的泡沫细胞形成的治疗剂的潜力。研究结果表明，在ox-LDL诱导条件下，化学处理后KLF2与PCSK9表达呈负相关。然而，KLF2对PCSK9的直接依赖性调控、GGTI298与PCSK9的直接结合以及PCSK9的功能抑制尚未确立，需要进一步的遗传学、生物化学和功能学验证。
